verdict.rationale: 2FAS documents export files for syncing tokens (2fas-docs-2), lets 2FAS Pass vaults be stored as an encrypted file on your own drive or cloud (2fas-docs-5, 2fas-docs-14), and a community post confirms import/export in the free tier of 2FAS Pass (2fas-comm-2). That gives a credible path to take your data with you, but nothing shows the exports are in an open or documented format, or that they can be imported into competing apps. The supported imports go only one way, into 2FAS (2fas-docs-1). Missing for 10: evidence of open or standard export formats (e.g. CSV, otpauth URIs, a documented JSON schema), confirmation that the export covers all data, evidence of migrating out to other apps, and hands-on verification of export.
